personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: I want features out fast. Don't park my consumer PR forever on a probe nobody wrote.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: My front-end PR merged before the field existed is exactly how a screen breaks in QA; holding it is what I want.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Fine if writing the probe stays optional for my repository and the kit never runs my code.

personas.name: Lead Engineer

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: A status comment that names what the pull request waits for tells me why it is still a draft.
